title: Emergency Service Call Premium and Dwelling Coverage (Water Damage Mitigation)
content:
Water Damage Mitigation coverage note. The emergency premium on the service call, being the job's service call line amounts less the tier's service call fee for each of those lines, is paid by the dwelling coverage when the dispatch answered the loss as it happened:
- when the premium is above zero and the job's opened date is two or more days after its loss date, the whole premium is a non-covered amount;
- when the premium is above zero and the opened date is exactly one day after the loss date, 40 percent of the premium is a non-covered amount;
- in any other case none of it is.

The service call lines are the job's own charge lines; the loss date and opened date are those on the job record, counted in calendar days.

## Worked figures (hypothetical: tier fee $200.00, service call lines of $270.00 and $200.00)
The premium is $470.00 less two fees of $200.00, that is $70.00.
| Opened | Non-covered part of the premium |
|---|---|
| on the loss date | none |
| one day after the loss | 40 percent of $70.00, that is $28.00 |
| two or more days after the loss | $70.00 |

A job whose service call lines all equal the tier's fee has no premium above zero, so nothing is non-covered under this note.
